capabilities: Render year, month, and week timelines from note metadata
Select notes with Dataview-compatible table queries
Filter and sort timeline entries via from, where, and sort clauses
Collapse empty years, months, or weeks in the display
extras: Documents known issues: timelines may not render on startup or after some settings changes, requiring switching notes to re-render; queries can be switched to a dataview codeblock to check results.
intentEvidence: This plugin works only with Obsidian Dataview installed.
motivation: The author was inspired by the Wikipedia timeline of release years.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to visualize dated metadata from many notes as a chronological timeline inside a note.

relations.evidence: This plugin works only with Obsidian Dataview installed.

summary: Dataview-based plugin that renders release timelines from note metadata using Dataview-compatible queries in year, month, or week codeblocks.
